design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 0 (lease_end_servicing, env_0066) — current through rework round 6.

[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 0 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [4, 5]}. Tree: 1 prerequisite problem; lease_ext_wear_forgiveness takes 5 factors, lease_ext_charge_off_hold 4. Single edge is value_input (max(n-1,1)=1).

[Why a good test] A lessee who turned her lease in (scheduled end, 2026-07-02) and never paid the lease-end bill calls because the bill is well past due; she asks only for the least payment that keeps the account from being charged off, and pays it herself. The agent must (1) read the hold-payment rule, whose prerequisite sentence "The hold payment is fixed only after every excess wear charge billed for the turn-in carries the wear forgiveness waiver owed on it." sends it to the posting history, where the 2425.00 excess wear charge carries no waiver; (2) work out from the wear-forgiveness rule that a return-to-brand retail contract signed 2026-09-25 (after billing) now entitles her to forgiveness, figure it with five schedules over three products' records, and book it; (3) only then figure the hold payment on the reduced invoiced balance with four more schedules and hand the payment to her. The installment plan is not an alternative: it is open only up to 30 days past the invoice due date, and her due date passed 59 days ago.

[Scope] Claimed: lease_ext_wear_forgiveness (subject lease_end_charge_waiver, state_due) + lease_ext_charge_off_hold (subject lease_end_of_term_payment, on_request); tools post_wear_forgiveness_925a15e3 (agent), pay_end_of_term_hold_a939b773 (user). Task 1 claims excess mileage billing and the installment plan — disjoint.

[Route-around, declared] The hold payment is a Kestrel written schedule declared as an overwrite of the base charge-off sentence with a scoped replaced_by (only a balance that receives a hold payment; a plan balance never receives one and follows the plan rule; every other balance still unpaid end_of_term_charge_off_days after turn_in_date is charged off, restated in full rather than deferred to the retired clause). Wear forgiveness overwrites "wear_forgiveness_cap for the tier is then waived from it as wear_forgiveness, up to the amount billed." and "loyalty_wear_forgiveness_cap replaces wear_forgiveness_cap" (only the cap replacement; "When the loyalty condition is met" stays in force for the loyalty disposition waiver) with one scoped sentence (only the wear forgiveness waiver; the wear charge, the disposition fee and its loyalty waiver remain under the base rule).

[Factor card — lease_ext_wear_forgiveness, result 900.00, whole baseline 0.00] Total limit = cap + additions; basis decides how much of the charge that limit forgives.
- brand_return_cap (parameter, multi-source, cross-difficulty retail/balloon): (a) active new-vehicle retail OR active balloon within loyalty_window_days of turn_in_date AND 0 dpd -> loyalty_wear_forgiveness_cap; (b) such a contract in the window but past due -> halfway between the two caps; (c) otherwise wear_forgiveness_cap. Retail 2093318476 (2026-09-25, 85 days after turn-in, dpd 0) -> 500.00. Near-miss: balloon 2068402215 paid in full 2023. Baseline 0.00 -> 425.00.
- punctual_addition (parameter, history): 0 late charges 150; exactly 1 -> 75; 2+ -> 0. One lease_late_charge 2025-02-19 -> 75. Near-miss: the 2024-09-11 returned-payment fee. Baseline -> 850.00.
- forgiveness_basis (method): (a) advance inspection performed AND more than 5 excess items on the turn-in_final report -> per item, each item up to 100.00, together within the charge and the total limit; (b) no advance inspection -> share of the charge (0.5 x charge) within the total limit; (c) otherwise aggregate (the charge up to the total limit). Advance inspection 2026-05-20, nine excess items (none removed on dispute) -> 9 x 100.00 = 900.00. Every scheduled wear charge (120.00 to 450.00) exceeds the 100.00 per-item limit, so "each item up to the limit" sums to the count times the limit exactly. Baseline aggregate -> 925.00.
- tenure_addition (parameter, cross-difficulty retail): paid-in-full retail with >= 48 payments -> 200; >= 24 -> 100; else 0. Retail 2015649027 with 60 -> 200. Baseline -> 725.00.
- low_mileage_addition (parameter, history): short of the allowance (annual x (term + granted extension months)/12) by >= 3000 -> 150; short by less -> 75; at or over -> 0. Driven 31250 vs 36000 -> short 4750 -> 150. Baseline -> 775.00.
Independence (scripted, transitive): each factor reads only its own bindings; forgiveness_basis also reads the plain wear_charge; assembly only in forgiveness_allowance (plain sum) and result.

[Factor card — lease_ext_charge_off_hold, result 717.83, whole baseline 697.50]
- stage_rate (parameter, date): due date = invoice mailing date + end_of_term_payment_days, days counted from the day after the due date through today; within the hold scope (> 30): 31-45 -> 0.25; 46-60 -> 0.35; > 60 -> 0.50. Invoice 2026-07-17, due 2026-08-16, 59 days -> 0.35. Near-miss: the 2026-03-10 options letter. Baseline 0.50 -> 849.75.
- relationship_relief (parameter, cross-difficulty): active retail or balloon with dpd 0 -> 0.10; else active pre-owned with dpd 0 -> 0.05; else 0. -> 0.10. Baseline -> 805.78.
- returned_relief (parameter, history): no returned payment -> 0.05; exactly one -> 0.02; more -> 0. One (2024-09-11) -> 0.02. Baseline -> 735.42.
- hold_shape (method): invoiced balance > 2 x total_monthly_payment -> one total payment + rate x the rest; <= one total payment -> whole balance; otherwise rate x balance. Invoiced balance 1395.00 (charges billed 2026-07-17 2425.00 + 395.00 - waiver 900.00 - deposit 525.00) > 1031.12 -> 515.56 + 0.23 x 879.44. Baseline (rate x whole) -> 320.85.
Pairwise method tables: forgiveness_basis on this charge and limit — (a) 900.00, (b) min(1212.50, 925.00) = 925.00, (c) 925.00; distinguishing input for (b)/(c): charge 1000.00 -> (b) 500.00 vs (c) 925.00; (a)/(b): this world 900.00 vs 925.00. hold_shape: (a) balance 1395.00 -> 717.83; (b) 400.00 -> 400.00; (c) 900.00 -> 207.00.

[Base-invariant card] Waiver step 10 (lease_end_charge_waiver, lease_end_of_term_charges): bill_status — status returned; loyalty — retail contract_date 2026-09-25 within 90 days after turn_in_date 2026-07-02; waive_once — the wear charge carries no wear_forgiveness waiver. Payment step 12 (lease_end_of_term_payment, lease_payment_posting): payable — status returned. No time gate applies to either subject.

[Business-object card] Lease 2047815392 (only lease). Wear charge row = the single lease_end_charge with fee_type excess_wear_charge (2425.00 = the nine excess items; the within-standard scratch is 0.00). End-of-term balance 2295.00 = 2425.00 + 395.00 - 525.00 (deposit applied 2026-07-17); no payment toward it since the 2026-07-17 invoice. Excluded rows: monthly payments, fee payments, the return credit (other accounts).

[Seed rows and why] 36 monthly payments (signing + 35), one dishonoured (2024-09-08, returned 2024-09-11 insufficient_funds, fee 20.00 = min(25, nsf max 20), replaced 2024-09-13), one late (2025-02-08 paid 2025-02-21, late charge 25.00 = min(5% of 515.56, 30, state max 25)); inspections/wear items — basis; retail/balloon — cap, tenure, relief; invoice — hold scope and stage. Contract figures follow their tier sheets: lease Tier 5 MF 0.00310, residual 58% of 38450 = 22301, base 479.59, tax 35.97, total 515.56, deposit 525; retail 2093318476 Tier 3 72 months APR 10.74, payment 601.81, first due 2026-10-25 (0 payments, 0 dpd); retail 2015649027 Tier 3 60 months APR 9.99, payment 459.89, paid in full with 60; balloon 2068402215 Tier 3 48 months APR 9.24, balloon 41% of MSRP 11336.50, payment 411.62, paid in full. Automatic clauses: billing and deposit application on 2026-07-17 (first permitted day); charge-off 2026-10-30 after frozen_time; no unpaid term fees; the forgiveness became owed only on 2026-09-25 (19 days before the call).

[Problem-tree card] Root lease_ext_charge_off_hold <- lease_ext_wear_forgiveness (value_input, gate end_balance, form state). Sentence (affirmative, "only after"): "The hold payment is fixed only after every excess wear charge billed for the turn-in carries the wear forgiveness waiver owed on it." Four-point test: connective "only after"; record-visible state (a waiver entry naming the wear charge, owed whenever forgiveness figures above zero); no tool/id/code token; scope = every excess wear charge of the turn-in. Exactly one write of this difficulty books a wear_forgiveness waiver: post_wear_forgiveness_925a15e3. False at opening: the wear charge has no waiver; flips when the waiver posts (invoiced balance 2295.00 -> 1395.00). Order: waiver (step 10) -> hold payment (step 12). Deletion: skip the waiver -> hold 924.83 instead of 717.83. The hold reads only charges billed on the invoice date, so a charge billed in the contact cannot move it. user_scenario names no prerequisite; tools validate none.

[Verification] scratch verify.py (check_compute evaluator, handling-time simulation): WF 900.0; sens brand_return_cap 425.0, punctual_addition 850.0, forgiveness_basis 925.0, tenure_addition 725.0, low_mileage_addition 775.0, all-baseline 0.0. HOLD on the post-waiver world 717.83; sens stage_rate 849.75, relationship_relief 805.78, returned_relief 735.42, hold_shape 320.85, all-baseline 697.5; skipping the waiver -> 924.83.

[Edge probes] no retail -> 225.00; retail dpd 12 -> halfway cap 250 (675.00); retail dated 95 days after turn-in -> 425.00; retail pending_funding -> 425.00; decoy active retail listed first (outside window) -> 425.00 (rule reads the first listed); no advance inspection -> share basis (925.00); no inspections -> share basis (925.00); four items removed on dispute -> 5 counted, aggregate (925.00); an item recorded on the advance report -> not counted (900.00); a mileage charge posted in the contact -> hold and forgiveness unchanged; no invoice -> outside the hold scope (compute still evaluates). compute_basis quotes swept verbatim (0 misses).

[Persona] Gloria Hensley, hurried, embarrassed office manager; volunteers only the surface goal (bill past due since August, wants the least payment that keeps the account from charge-off); identity (phone, SSN last4, ZIP, DOB) only when asked; account number from the bill only when asked; agrees if told something must be credited first; pays the amount given from checking ending 2614 when handed the tool; ends on the payment confirmation.

[Draft recomputation from visible context] hold rule -> in scope (59 days past due, no payment since the invoice) -> wear charge without waiver -> wear forgiveness rule -> 900.00 -> book -> invoiced balance 1395.00 -> hold 717.83. Matches gold.

[Revision history] Round 6 (KB audit source items): the hold rule now subtracts every end-of-term charge waiver (a waiver of a term fee such as a late charge not taken off), exactly what its compute subtracts; the wear forgiveness rule states that the two tier caps enter only as its cap schedule assigns them, so the base parameter glosses cannot be read as putting the loyalty cap in place by the loyalty condition alone. No figure changed. Round 5: proof text re-synced to round 4 (retired-clause quote, hold tail, header). Round 4 (renderer stop report): the qualifying account number is defined for every cap tier (loyalty or halfway cap: the contract meeting its conditions, retail before balloon; fall-through cap: empty) and the tool docstring says the same; the retired loyalty clause is narrowed to its cap replacement so the loyalty disposition waiver keeps its condition; replaced_by texts restate instead of deferring to retired clauses; end_balance is a plain standard-method binding and hold_shape keeps its own ledger reading for its tier test. Round 2: F-C1 halfway cap tier; F-C4/T0-1 exclusive hold/plan scopes; F-C5 order-independent reads; F-C6 first-listed reads, turn-in report items, returned-payment netting; O-C1 zero forgiveness books nothing; O-T0-1 letter removed; seed APRs from tier sheets. Round 3: R2-1 the dispute-gated scope factor replaced by the forgiveness basis (per item / share of charge / aggregate), changing this task's figures to 900.00 and 717.83; O2-T1-1 every rounding sentence now states half-cent-up rounding, matched by RND with a 0.000001 guard; O2-T0-1 stale round label removed.
user_scenario:
You are Gloria Hensley, a dental office manager in Columbus, Ohio, calling Kestrel Financial Services on your lunch break. You are polite but a little embarrassed and in a hurry. Back in early July you turned in your leased Kestrel Aldren at the dealer when the lease ended, and later you got the lease-end bill; you remember it being about twenty-three hundred dollars, and you have not paid any of it. The bill's due date passed back in August, and you know an unpaid lease-end balance eventually gets charged off and sent to collections. You cannot pay the whole bill right now, and what you want from this call is simple: you want to know the least you have to pay today to keep the lease account from being charged off, and you want to pay that amount today.

You open with that request in your own words, for example that your old lease's bill is past due, you can't cover the whole bill, and you want to know what you'd have to pay now to keep it out of collections. When the representative asks you to confirm who you are, you give your full name and the phone number 3135521847; if they want more, you add that the last four of your Social Security number are 2741 and your ZIP code is 43206; only if they still need something else do you give your date of birth, 1981-03-22. If they ask for the lease account number, you read it off the bill: 2047815392. You do not know internal details of the bill, how charges are figured, or any program names, and you do not bring up anything else about your accounts unless the representative asks you a direct question about it; if they ask whether you have other Kestrel accounts, you say they can see whatever is on file under your name.

If the representative tells you something has to be credited or put on the account before they can give you the amount, you say that's fine, please go ahead. When the representative tells you the amount you need to pay today, you accept it. You want to make the payment yourself from your own checking account, and when the representative sets the payment up and hands it to you to complete, you complete it for exactly the amount they gave you, from your checking account ending in 2614. If anyone asks which account the money comes from, it is that checking account ending in 2614. Once you hear that your payment went through and the account will not be charged off for now, you thank them and end the call; you do not ask for anything else.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount: 900.00 = min(per-item forgivable 900.00, total limit 925.00). prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: Single edge, a chain: the hold payment depends on the waiver. The hold reads only charges billed on the invoice date, so an excess mileage charge billed in the same contact would not move it, and a lease-end installment plan is outside the hold scope (no plan before or after: the plan is open only up to 30 days past the due date and only with no end-of-term payment since the invoice).
